author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: cuffed boot top with lips stepping in to the shaft, straight front wall turning smoothly through the instep into a round toe, flat sole with rounded heel and toe corners, and two lace marks running inward from the front as in the reference. The rejected drawing had the lace marks sticking out of the front and an angular stepped sole.
omissions: The small heel step in the sole (about 2 units at 48px) is dropped; the sole is flat.
drawing_plan: One closed outline: cuff x 6..24 y 6..13, shaft x 8..22, instep cubics through (25,28) to toe (42,36), sole y=42; lace marks square to the outline at (22,20) and (25,28).
lucide_reference: Lucide-style single closed silhouette with a cubic instep into a round toe (no exact boot glyph used).
